items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: capture survives a page CSP, board states via closed steps, design-screen wording fixed in the three named places

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: malformed steps are a per-screen error; a failing step fails that job with its number, never a silent shot of the initial state

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: step vocabulary closed to click/fill/wait_for with selectors only, max 10, no navigation or script step

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: real Chromium CSP board: state equals its design screen, no-steps control fails; failing step and malformed-step cases covered

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: timeout budget grows 15 s per step

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: extends the existing check and capture tool, new test file about 110 lines

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: screen-routes.json to Python to jobs.json to node capture: round trip proved by the real-browser tests
